fee_notes: Fee of $8,500 is paid in one lump sum, fully earned and nonrefundable upon receipt, and imposed uniformly on all franchisees. If franchisee fails to complete initial training within 60 days, franchisor may terminate and retain 50% of the fee (returning the other 50%). A pre-opening termination fee of $1,000 plus out-of-pocket expenses may apply if a health or personal issue prevents operations before opening.
raw_excerpt: Upon signing the Franchise Agreement, you must pay us an Initial Franchise Fee in the amount of Eight Thousand Five hundred Dollars ($8,500). This amount is payable in one lump sum payment, is considered fully earned and nonrefundable upon receipt, and is imposed uniformly on all franchisees.
